title: Retain the selected visible vista rings with their support-sampling policy
classification: Source-backed valid configuration/aggregate mismatch; finite checked custom scene witness, no rendering execution or introduced774 regression claim
contract_trace: on_scene_vista_bundle limits visible_lods to maximum_lods and PreparedVistaLod::prepare_all uses only the next visible ring as its coarser source. ActiveVistaSurface::update independently retains the first two original bundle rings regardless of that selection. Its presented_height_at morphs to the retained second ring. terrain_detail_patch_mesh uses that result for unmorphed fine vertices within eight metres of its camera-local centre. Retained sampled heights can therefore differ from the actual selected visible first-ring mesh even though both sources and configuration are individually valid.

At local(3,0) first-ring rendered mesh has no coarser source and seam height15 (between boundaryx2 height10 and x4 height20). ActiveVistaSurface nevertheless uses second-ring morph weight3/4, producing vista35 then seam22.5. A detail-patch centre0 includes that vertex at radialdistance3, below its8m morphstart, and publishes22.5. This is source/numerical algebra only, not a new test or executed customscene; no default shipped terrain or ordinary player-visible failure is asserted. maximum_lods0 is also a required valid selection policy and must not retain unrendered sample authority.
